title: Frame-free first build: keep the built hasScheduledFrame recheck; no second amendment; device opens measured with a frame-free ready wait
context: Diagnostics on the owner's Windows PC showed the built first build ran entirely on frames under the perf harness (freeBatches 0, first scene 806-810 ms, above 10.12's 700 ms), because the harness's ready op loops scheduleFrame plus endOfFrame and the built _timerFired rechecks hasScheduledFrame. A variant without the recheck reached 509-530 ms under that harness. A quietready op that polls debugIsReady on 2 ms Future.delayed and schedules no frames was added to kit/lib/perf/perf_lab.dart and the PC checkout, and base3 (6b09587 + harness), diag (ef95801d + batch counters) and norecheck (diag without the recheck) were rebuilt and measured, maximized at 4K with the seeded journal (6,838 days / 23,939 entries), 3 opens each plus a held-out windowed case.
options: Keep the recheck as built and measure first opens with quietready
Second amendment: drop the hasScheduledFrame recheck in _timerFired so a timer scheduled frame-free always runs frame-free
option_reasons: With quietready the built change (diag) ran 17-18 frame-free batches and showed the first scene in 283, 302 and 295 ms (settle 1,103-1,112 ms, max frame after open 62-65 ms, none over 250 ms, peak video memory 5.9-7.5 GB; held-out windowed 371 ms, max 64.8 ms); the recheck only keeps the build on frames while something else is drawing, which protects those frames from eviction

Norecheck measured 297-306 ms first scene and 7.4-7.5 GB with quietready, no better than the built change in real use, while letting frame-free batches straddle visible frames and requiring the on-frames test rows to be reworked
outcome: Keep the recheck; no second amendment. The 806 ms first scene was a harness artifact. The unchanged build crashed with the Impeller GLES framebuffer FATAL in 2 of 3 opens (14.5-14.7 GB) and took 11,318 ms to settle with 30 frames over 250 ms in the third. Final device verification (10.12-10.14) uses quietready for every open, including the full-screen re-open; results in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-perf/kit/results/win/quiet.log and Q-*.json.
